intended_object: The incidence set of a vertex v in a simple graph G: the set of edges of G that contain v. This comes from the docstring and the name.
explanation: The definition is the set {e ∈ G.edgeSet | v ∈ e}. This is exactly the set of edges of G incident to v, which is the textbook definition. The setting is already the most general one: any vertex type V and any simple graph on it, with no finiteness or other assumptions. This is Mathlib's own definition of the notion, so there is no separate Mathlib counterpart to cite.
